exitCriteria.title: PENDING or uncorroborated ACTIVE never renders as recorded harvest
exitCriteria.reason: The lifecycle normalizer maps PENDING to planned and ACTIVE to authorised; only RETIRED maps to recorded-harvest. Fixtures exercise every lifecycle.

exitCriteria.title: Québec north of 52 grades national baseline, not enhanced
exitCriteria.reason: The coverage resolver returns national-baseline for Québec at latitude 52 or greater before considering local periods; the coverage query test exercises a latitude of 53.

exitCriteria.title: Match rate, non-match rate, and non-match-reason distribution are published on the methods page
exitCriteria.reason: The methods page explicitly reports these results as unavailable; no admitted, versioned provincial processing run exists from which numeric rates or a reason distribution can be published.

exitCriteria.title: Salvage, partial cut, and thinning are distinguished where supported and undetermined otherwise
exitCriteria.reason: The event subtype contract allows salvage, partial-cut, and thinning, defaults an omitted source subtype to undetermined, and fixtures/test assertions exercise all four outcomes.

checkpoints.title: Rights/admission
checkpoints.reason: No BC or Québec optional source has both verified rights and production-admitted evidence.

checkpoints.title: Outside provincial review
checkpoints.reason: The owner decided not to pursue BC or Québec human review. No outside provincial review or reviewer sign-off occurred, so this checkpoint remains blocked rather than treating a waiver as completed review.

localControls: The optional-enhancement availability gate protects absent optional data as bilingual Unknown; it does not substitute for the separate rights/admission or outside-review checkpoints. The owner's decision not to pursue human review is recorded as a continuing blocker, not as evidence that review occurred.
